architecture.mechanism: Fuzzy semantic optimal control with reinforcement learning and proximal policy optimization to maximize output under uncertainty.
architecture.intervention: Apply a fuzzy semantic optimal control layer to the EV’s motor controller and energy management system, using reinforcement learning with PPO to continuously optimize torque delivery and regenerative braking based on real-time driving context and semantic similarity of driving patterns.
architecture.expected_effect: Improved acceleration beyond Tesla Model Y while reducing energy consumption per kilometer below BYD Seal by dynamically balancing power output and energy recovery.
architecture.falsification_test: Run standardized 0–100 km/h acceleration and WLTP energy consumption tests on the EV with and without the fuzzy semantic optimal control layer; the mechanism is falsified if acceleration does not exceed Tesla Model Y or energy consumption per km is not lower than BYD Seal.
